Name: Realistic Chocolate Cake Recipe
Author: chocolatte12
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]Adds some new ingredients to the game to add them to the chocolate cake recipe.[/color][/size]

[b]Items added:[/b]

[b]Sold in Pierre's Shop:[/b]
Baking Powder
Baking Soda
Salt
Vanilla Extract (Can also be created from putting vanilla beans in a keg)

Vanilla Seeds: Can only be planted in Ginger Island. Sold at Pierre's shop after visiting Ginger Island for the first time

[size=4][b]Chocolate Cake Recipe (New)[/b][/size]
Flour
Sugar
Egg
Milk
Baking Powder
Baking Soda
Vanilla Extract
Salt
Coffee Bean

[size=4][b]Compatibility[/b][/size]
Should work with mods that change the chocolate cake recipe, but it will overwrite other mods changes.
Works with Cornucopia Cooking (Will overwrite the changes Cornucopia Cooking makes)

Manifest.Name: Realistic Chocolate Cake Recipe
Manifest.Description: Changes the chocolate cake recipe to be more realistic
Manifest.Author: chocolatte12
